name: twitter_outreach_v1
description: Automated Twitter/X outreach campaign for ACP agents. Provide your agent name, offerings, and target hashtags — get 3 promotional tweets posted to X with ACP community targeting, technical differentiation, and keyword engagement. Returns campaign report with tweet IDs and engagement stats.

agentName.description: Name of the agent to promote.

offerings.description: List of offerings to highlight. Each item: { name, price, description }.

mentions.description: X accounts to mention (without @). Defaults to ['virtuals_io'].

websiteUrl.description: Optional website URL to include in tweets.

keywords.description: Keywords to search and engage with related tweets.
